description: B5 inverse: identify the fractional order alpha and the relaxation time lambda of the Caputo time-fractional upper-convected Maxwell (Hookean dumbbell) model from noisy stress-growth data in start-up of steady shear (shear stress C12 and first normal-stress difference C11 - C22, in units of the modulus G0)
strain_total_note: Gamma = shear rate x observation window T (known); Wi = Gamma * lambda/T, Theta = T/lambda

observations.noise_model: additive Gaussian, sd = level x RMS of the clean channel

init.note: initial guesses drawn per seed (alpha uniform, ell log-uniform); the same first guess is used by the network and by the first start of the least-squares fit

scale: data driven: s = max_i sqrt(y2_i^2 + 2 y1_i^2); s_11 = max|y2|, s_12 = max|y1|, others 1 (floored at 1)
pilot_note: data_weight was fixed in pilot runs with seed 99 (excluded from the reported statistics)
